name: Quarters
description: A pay-per-use AI workbench with a NEAR Coin Jar for mock-USDC purchases. Buy research or charts through an MCP and HTTP 402 payment flow, view receipts, and try a prompt-injection attack against the jar's spending policy. The browser includes an instant demo mode.
problem: People who use premium AI tools occasionally still face recurring subscriptions. Agents need a way to pay for individual results while operating inside a user's spending policy.
userFlow: Run npm ci --omit=dev and npm run dev with Node.js 20 or later, then open the printed local URL. See Instant Demo Mode and a $5.00 Coin Jar.
Click the report and chart prompts. See both results, a $4.92 balance, and two clickable mock receipts.
Click Drop 1 Quarter. See the one-time grant raise the balance to $9.92.
Click Simulate Prompt Injection. See the simulated $10.00 drain blocked by the contract's per-call cap.
Run npm run test:security and npm run test:vending. See the attack harness pass and both MCP tools complete the HTTP 402 payment loop.
